sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 700. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Abstraction for 40 seconds with a success value of 120.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Insanity for 40 seconds with a success value of 120.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Magic Penalty for 40 seconds with a success value of 120.
-Target: all allies. Applies Dawn for 150 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; applies Dual Attack; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 150 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Resolute Element (increases all stats by 120%, increases max HP by 120%, and increases status ailment resistance by 30) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 100 for 150 seconds.
Light and Time Defense from Unison Damage +700
